# Giant Pygmy

> > Giant Pygmy is a curated marketplace and creative studio specializing in premium photography equipment and niche outdoor gear from independent retailers.

Giant Pygmy operates as both a creative studio (GP-Net Media) and a specialized e-commerce platform (SYSTEM shop) focused on high-quality camera accessories, lens hoods, tripods, and photography equipment. The site emphasizes product curation, quality assurance, and partnerships with independent makers.

## Key Topics

- SYSTEM shop
- GP-Net Media
- Photography equipment
- Camera accessories
- Lens hoods (Massa brand)
- Tripod gear (Scrambler)
- Product curation
- Independent retailers
- Studio portfolio
- Niche products
- Outdoor equipment
- Quality assurance

## Shop & Commerce

- [SYSTEM Shop Homepage](https://www.giantpygmy.net/shop): Curated niche products from independent retailers featuring photography equipment and specialty outdoor gear
- [SYSTEM Shop Index](https://giantpygmy.net/shop/index.php): Shop entry point for curated specialist items and product catalog

## Studio & Portfolio

- [GP-Net Media Studio](https://www.giantpygmy.net/studio): Creative studio portfolio showcasing photography equipment, camera accessories, and studio work
